Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS) using biotinylated RNA baits to capture pre-mRNA processing complexes. Acquisition is DDA (implied by Q-Exactive and Xcalibur usage for protein identification via Mascot). Quantification is label-free (LFQ) using both spectral counting and MS1 intensities.

scope: Streptavidin–agarose beads (Merck), previously equilibrated with binding buffer, were added and the suspensions were placed on a rotating wheel for 90 min at 4°C, in order to allow binding of the complexes onto the beads.

Eluted pre-mRNA processing complexes were finally recovered by centrifugation (20 g, 3 min, 4°C) and supernatant collection, and either used for sodium dodecylsulfate (SDS)–polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS–PAGE) and subsequent western blot or mass spectrometry (MS) analysis
